svg.aria-label: Polar plots of two stable transfer functions. Left: G4(s) = (s + 1)/(s squared + s + 1) stays in the closed right half-plane, with real part 1/((1 − w squared) squared + w squared) > 0 for all w: it is strictly positive real. Right: G3(s) = 1/(s squared + s + 1) has relative degree 2, so its phase reaches −180 degrees and it crosses into the left half-plane: not positive real

g.text: solid: ω ≥ 0 dashed: ω < 0 shaded: left half-plane
